newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ dollar closes easier against muscular US unit.
newsitem.headline: NZ dollar closes easier against muscular US unit.

text.p: The New Zealand dollar closed easier on Tuesday against the muscular U.S. unit and dealers said they expected further downward pressure.
At 5.20 p.m. (0520 GMT) it stood at US$0.6875/82, from its 0.6892/99 opening.
Dealers said the kiwi had failed to convincingly breach 0.6885 but even if it eased back, it nevertheless had solid support at 0.6850.
They predicted the kiwi would remain within a 0.6860-90 range overnight.
The Trade-Weighted Index sustained its buoyant opening level at 68.40 thanks mainly to the U.S. dollar's strength against the yen.
TWI sellers were running out of ammunition, traders said, and they expected the basket-based index to remain strong.
